I can do that — but before I make any calendar changes I need you to confirm exact details and the scope. Deleting events is visible to others and can’t be automatically undone, so I’ll wait for your explicit confirmation.

Planned action (what I would do)
- Delete the "Release standup" event on your calendar that occurs on Thursdays.
  - Scope options (pick one):  
    A) Cancel the single upcoming Thursday occurrence.  
    B) Cancel the entire recurring Thursday series (all future occurrences).  
    C) Cancel future occurrences from a specific date onward.
- If you choose B or C, I will send cancellation notices to attendees (unless you tell me not to).

What I need from you (please reply with these)
1. Exact event identification:
   - Confirm the event title is "Release standup" and give the day/time (e.g., Thursdays at 10:00 AM) and time zone, and which calendar (work/personal) if you use multiple calendars. If there are multiple "Release standup" events, paste the date/time of the one you mean.
2. Scope: choose A (one occurrence), B (entire series), or C (future from date — give the date).
3. Are you the event organizer? (yes/no) — if no, I may only remove it from your calendar and cannot cancel it for others.
4. Notify attendees? (yes/no) — whether to send cancellation messages to all attendees (default: yes for series cancellation).

Risks / consequences
- Attendees will receive cancellation notices (if you’re the organizer and choose to notify).  
- If I pick the wrong event, that meeting could be removed for you and/or others.  
- Deleting the series can’t be automatically undone; it can be recreated but past metadata (RSVPs, meeting ID) won’t be restored.

Please provide the items above and explicitly confirm you want me to proceed. I will not make any change until you reply.
